scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,mdns -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run mdns -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build && npm run mdns -w server
